card.name: Potassium-binding exchange resins and nearby dosing
card.fires_on: Words in and around ion exchange resin text, such as the 'y' in Polystyrene, 'ation' in cation, and 'as' in 'resins such as'. It also fires on spaces before dose amounts in potassium or resin dosing.

modes.label: Exchange resin names
modes.description: Partway through or right after resin terms like cation exchange or sodium polystyrene sulfonate.

modes.label: Linking words before resin examples
modes.description: The word 'as' or 'e.g.,' just before a named resin or ion exchange example.
modes.example: Exchange resins, such<< as>> sodium polystyrene sulfonate

modes.label: Space before a dose amount
modes.description: A blank spot before a number in potassium or resin dose instructions.
modes.example: The average daily adult dose is<< >>15 g (60 mL)

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'exchange' next, as in exchange resin, and away from 'new'.
card.plain: It lights up in text about potassium-binding exchange resins, where the next word is likely 'exchange'.
